name: io.github.DB-25/arc-control-mcp
title: Arc Control (macOS)
description: Arc browser MCP for macOS: agent window, snapshots, DevTools input, guardrails

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_LABEL
environmentVariables.description: Names this agent's tab ownership. Two agents with different labels never see each other's owned tabs. Defaults to "default".

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_SPACE
environmentVariables.description: With ARC_MCP_WINDOW=space, the Arc space new tabs open into, when a space with that name exists. Arc will not let a script create a space, so make it by hand. Defaults to "Agent".

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where per-session tab ownership is recorded, so a restarted agent can clean up the tabs its previous run left behind. Defaults to ~/Library/Application Support/arc-control-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_WINDOW
environmentVariables.description: "dedicated" keeps agent tabs in one separate agent window, never the user's own. "space" puts them in the Agent space of the user's window. Defaults to "dedicated".

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_WINDOW_PLACEMENT
environmentVariables.description: Where the agent window goes once, at creation: "auto" (largest non-main display, else where Arc puts it), "second-display", "minimized" (experimental) or "none". Needs Accessibility. Defaults to "auto".

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_IDLE_MS
environmentVariables.description: How many milliseconds the user must have been idle before the server does anything visible. 0 turns the activity gate off. Defaults to 1500.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_IDLE_WAIT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How many milliseconds to wait for that pause before failing with userActive true. Defaults to 15000.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_ARC_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory the local data tools (sidebar_tree, find_stale_tabs, search_archive, search_history) read Arc's files from. Defaults to ~/Library/Application Support/Arc.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_ALLOW_HISTORY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let search_history run. Off by default, and any other value leaves it off.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_CDP
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to disable the DevTools engine (trusted input, screenshots, console and network capture). On by default, and inert until Arc is launched with --remote-debugging-port.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_CDP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The DevTools port to probe on 127.0.0.1. The host is fixed. Defaults to 9222.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Guardrail. Comma list of origins the agent may touch (host, *.host, scheme://host[:port], file://, about:). Anything not listed is refused. Unset means no allow list.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_BLOCKED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Guardrail. Comma list of origins the agent may not touch. Wins over the allow list. Unset means no block list.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_BLOCK_READS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to apply the origin lists to read tools as well as changing ones. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose only the read-only tools. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path of a file that gets one JSON line per changing call (time, tool, tab, origin, ok, error), never typed values or script code. Unset means no audit log.
